metadata.purpose: Emit an initial live window and rotate it on boundary next; route source values into the current multicast window.

conditions: One initial handle is emitted on result connection, followed by one handle for every accepted boundary next.
Each window exposes only source values observed while it is current and that consumer is attached.
Boundary complete does not complete the result; outer cancellation does not complete its current window consumers.

scope.parameters: Valid Observable boundary input; observers use only the Observable-facing interface of emitted handles.
scope.callbacks: No user callback; payloads and boundary notification values are opaque.
scope.time: Source, boundary and consumer events supply trace time. Equal-time order is explicit input order; no clock, buffer or scheduler is introduced.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant reactions after source/boundary setup returns. Consumer attachment is an explicit event between reactions; synchronous setup and callback-driven reentry are characterized separately.
exclusions: Synchronous source/boundary notifications during setup and consumer attachment/cancellation inside an action word.
Imperative next/error/complete access on the later Subject objects; the model specifies their Observable-facing behavior.
Subscription to the invalidated final current handle is outside the modeled legal alphabet; native tests separately verify ObjectUnsubscribedError.
Physical Subject/Observable prototype identity and observer-thrown errors.
Throwing observer/producer teardown, arbitrary reentrancy and universal infinite-trace liveness are not modeled.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Emit window zero, subscribe source, then subscribe boundary. Model inputs after subscribe assume both setup calls returned without synchronous delivery.

ownership.sharing: Each result subscription owns its own source/boundary subscriptions and windows. Each emitted window is live multicast without replay; its consumers never retain the original source after outer cancellation.
ownership.reset: Create fresh bookkeeping for each result connection. Payload objects are not cloned.

dispatch.actionSemantics: Notifications are addressed to outer downstream or explicit window observers. Tokens identify emitted handles; initial/later prototype differences are normalized. Subject invalidation is state, not a fabricated consumer-unsubscribe action.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between external reactions. Cancellation during synchronous multi-action delivery is characterized separately, not silently admitted into this profile.

inputs.description: First connection to this result execution.
A value from the currently owned source subscription.
Source failure with an opaque error value.
Consumer closes the result connection silently.
Current boundary subscription emits; payload is ignored.
Boundary stops without closing the current window.
Boundary fails with an opaque error payload.
A fresh addressed consumer attaches to a known open or previously rotated completed window.
An attached or orphaned consumer closes its own subscription.

controls.description: See the typed state and named transitions for Active.
Outer/source execution ended; retained completed handles and orphaned consumer subscriptions remain observable through their own lifecycle events.

sources.purpose: Upstream scenario basis; test bodies inspected, not claimed to have been executed as the upstream suite.

rules.nextState: Window zero is open; both inputs are owned; no window consumer is attached yet.
rules.explanation: The initial window precedes either input subscription. Subsequent modeled events begin after setup returns.

actions: deliver original value to current window consumers in attachment order
rules.nextState: The same window remains open; values are not buffered or retained for late consumers.
rules.explanation: A window is a live multicast stream. Source values sent before an observer attaches are not replayed.

rules.guard: boundary is live and next window identity is a safe integer
actions: complete each current consumer and release its subscription
rules.nextState: Previous window remains a completed historical handle; a new empty current window has no consumers.
rules.explanation: Every boundary next rotates the window, even if no source value arrived. Boundary payloads are ignored.

rules.nextState: Current window and source remain live; no further boundary events are legal.
rules.explanation: Boundary completion is a no-op for window/result notifications. It does not close the current window.

actions: complete current consumers and release their subscriptions
release source and any live boundary
invalidate current handle during operator teardown
rules.nextState: Outer execution stopped; older rotated handles remain completed; current handle is invalidated.
rules.explanation: Current-window completion precedes outer completion. Final operator teardown unsubscribes the current Subject itself.

actions: error current consumers and release their subscriptions
error outer result with identical payload
release source and any live boundary
rules.nextState: Outer execution stopped with error; older completed handles are unchanged.
rules.explanation: Both input failures reach current-window consumers before the outer observer. The error payload is never replaced.

actions: error current consumers and release their subscriptions
error outer result with identical payload
release source and any live boundary
rules.nextState: Outer execution stopped with error; older completed handles are unchanged.
rules.explanation: Both input failures reach current-window consumers before the outer observer. The error payload is never replaced.

actions: release source and any live boundary
invalidate current handle without notifying or closing existing consumer subscriptions
rules.nextState: Outer execution stopped; its current consumers are orphaned until they unsubscribe themselves.
rules.explanation: Subject.unsubscribe is not Subject.complete. Window consumers do not hold a lease that preserves the original source.

rules.guard: fresh observer identity names the current open window
actions: acquire addressed window-consumer subscription; replay nothing
rules.nextState: Observer joins the current multicast window after existing consumers.
rules.explanation: Attaching a window observer does not acquire another source or boundary subscription.

rules.guard: fresh observer identity names a previously rotated completed handle
rules.nextState: No active consumer or source lease is added; observer identity is recorded as used.
rules.explanation: Retired completed windows remember completion but never replay values. The final current handle is separately invalidated and excluded from this legal event.

rules.nextState: Consumer is removed; source/boundary ownership and the current window do not change.
rules.explanation: Consumer cancellation is local to that window observer; it never closes the shared window or outer source.

rules.nextState: No active consumer or source lease is added; observer identity is recorded as used.
rules.explanation: Retired completed windows remember completion but never replay values. The final current handle is separately invalidated and excluded from this legal event.

rules.nextState: Consumer is removed; source/boundary ownership and the current window do not change.
rules.explanation: An outer-cancelled Subject leaves already attached Subscription objects open until consumers close them.
